definition: [ דָּבַב ] verb move gently, glide, glide over (Late Hebrew דָּבַב flow slowly, drop ; Arabic walk leisurely, gently , any animal that walks or creeps , compare דֹּב ; Assyrian dabâbu , plot , plan , COT Gloss , compare דִּבָּה ) — only Qal Participle דּוֺבֵב שִׂפְתֵי יְשֵׁנִים Song 7:10 , of wine gliding over the lips of sleepers ; ( שְׂפָתַי וְשִׁנָּי֑ ׳ ד i.e. my lips and teeth ᵐ5 ᵑ6 Aq Gei Urschrift 405 ).

[דָּבַב] verb move gently, glide, glide over (Late Hebrew דָּבַב flow slowly, drop; Arabic walk leisurely, gently, any animal that walks or creeps, compare דֹּב; Assyrian dabâbu, plot, plan, COTGloss, compare דִּבָּה) — only Qal Participle דּוֺבֵב שִׂפְתֵי יְשֵׁנִים Song 7:10, of wine gliding over the lips of sleepers; (שְׂפָתַי וְשִׁנָּי֑ ׳ד i.e. my lips and teeth ᵐ5 ᵑ6 Aq GeiUrschrift 405).
